BR_VisualGuardrails.text: NO literal junkyard aesthetic. NO piles of random trash as production design. NO Mad-Max-like grime-for-grime's-sake. NO grimdark underexposure. NO generic post-apocalyptic brown haze. NO tiny toy-like rockets when the story calls for launch vehicles. NO interchangeable Tethergrid and Launch-Shop technology. Keep the Southwest bright, vast, colorful and geologically beautiful; keep legacy Launch-Shop machines intentional and maintained; keep Tethergrid visibly newer, cleaner and more automated.
